Replied in #north-team to Marcus: noted that he'll be on the road tomorrow morning and reachable on mobile, and that he can DM me if he needs anything while he's away.

My reply includes the line "I haven't posted or changed anything on your behalf." That's inaccurate, since the post itself is an action. I can't edit or delete it with my tools, so if you want it cleaned up, someone with channel access will need to do that.
